//: Example Meteor settings for a local run. Copy this file to settings.dev.json (git-ignored) and fill in only the keys for the features you use; an empty value leaves that feature off. Never commit a settings file with real values. Production and test read their settings from METEOR_SETTINGS (a Kubernetes Secret), and a self-hosted install writes its own .state/settings.json (see self-host/README.md).

slateboxAPI.//: The key pair the collaboration relay is given as API_KEYS ([{"name":"slatebox","publicKey":...,"secretKey":...}]); live editing between people needs it. self-host/init.mjs makes one. Left empty, editing and saving still work.

googleImageSearch.//: Picture search (Google Programmable Search). Server only: never move these into public.

nounProject.//: Icon search for custom shapes and the style bar (The Noun Project API key and secret, OAuth 1.0a). Leave both empty to turn icon search off: the custom shape pane then offers only drawing with AI.

mailGun.//: SMTP URL for login links, invitations and password resets, e.g. smtps://user:password@smtp.example.com:465

chatWoot.//: HMAC token Chatwoot uses to verify a signed-in user. The widget itself is configured under public.chatWoot.

googleDocs.//: The OAuth client for the Google integration (enterprise: free for everyone, on Cloud and on every self-hosted install; docs/integrations.md). A Google Cloud web application client whose consent screen asks only for drive.file; add the app's origin to its Authorized JavaScript origins (the sign-in is Google's popup, so no redirect address is used). Server only.

google.//: apiBase: one fake Google for every Google API (tests). Honored only on a development server, and only at 127.0.0.1 or localhost.

stripe.//: Slatebox Cloud only (Slatebox Pro, Slatebox Business and balances; off unless the Cloud license is present); leave empty for local development and self-hosting. Server only. apiBase overrides the Stripe API host (tests); apiVersion pins a dated Stripe API release (empty keeps the built-in one). businessPortalConfiguration: an optional customer portal configuration (bpc_...) for a team's Slatebox Business card and receipts.

business.//: Slatebox Business bought in the app for a team (server/business-billing.mjs). The ids of two recurring, per-unit, licensed Stripe prices the owner makes in Stripe: monthly and yearly, quantity = the team's members who have joined (invitations not yet accepted are not billed). The sheet shows the amount Stripe has for them. Slatebox Cloud only (its Cloud key, server/cloud-lock.mjs). With either id empty, Business is not sold in the app and the team page says Talk to us.

ai.//: People's and teams' own AI connections and keys (Profile, AI; team settings): optional on Slatebox Cloud, where a request they serve spends no Slatebox credits and an own connection must be a public https address, and on a self-hosted Slatebox, where they or the administrator's keys turn agent features on. ownProviders: "on" (the default) or "off" (nobody may use their own; an administrator can also turn them off in the app). privateEndpoints: self-hosted only, "on" (the default) lets own connections use your LAN or host.docker.internal, "off" keeps them on public addresses; Slatebox Cloud always refuses private, loopback, link-local and metadata addresses. Keys are sealed with SLATEBOX_KEY_ENCRYPTION_KEY from the environment, never from this file.

metering.//: Slatebox Cloud only: its AI and call meter. It runs only where public.edition is cloud and enterprise.license holds Slatebox Cloud's own key (server/cloud-lock.mjs): anywhere else there is no meter, whatever this says. Leave it off for local development and self-hosting. See server/metering/README.md.

public.//: Everything under public reaches every browser. Only keys that are meant to be public belong here. edition: "self-host" (the default when missing) or "cloud" (Slatebox Cloud only, imports/api/common/edition.mjs; it unlocks nothing without Slatebox Cloud's own key in enterprise.license). The server adds public.enterprise itself at start (whether enterprise code is unlocked here); do not set it.

google.//: The Google Picker (Import from Google Drive, Drive files): an API key restricted to this app's address and the Picker API, and the Google Cloud project number. Both are public by nature.

agents.//editDirectly: Lets the person who brought an agent (or the slate owner) let it save without suggestions, each change undoable. Off unless true.

stripe.//: Slatebox Cloud only. In-app payments (Stripe Payment Element). Set the publishable key (pk_...) that pairs with stripePrivateKey; without one, payments use the hosted Stripe page. inApp: false turns the in-app sheet off. At startup the app checks the pair and sets inApp itself.

chatWoot.//: Chatwoot support widget. It loads only when websiteToken is set; enabled: false turns it off.

analytics.//: Google Analytics. The gtag config is served only when gaId (a G- measurement id) is set.

enterprise.//: Integrations (enterprise/: outside agent connections, invited agents and Google) are free everywhere: they run on every self-hosted install with no key, and on Slatebox Cloud, which proves itself with Cloud's own signed key (kind cloud, naming Cloud's host names in public.baseUrl). Slatebox Cloud only: license holds that key; or licenseFile a file holding it; or the SLATEBOX_LICENSE or SLATEBOX_LICENSE_FILE environment variables. Checked offline at start (server/enterprise-license.mjs). A self-hosted install leaves both empty.

connectors.//off: The kill switch for invited agents wherever enterprise code runs: true takes "+ Invite agent" and every connectors call away. Leave false.
connectors.//: Enterprise (enterprise/). oauthApps: apps registered with a vendor ahead of time. The client id is public; the client secret comes from this file or the environment that fills it, never from code. The OAuth callback is <public.baseUrl>/connectors/oauth/callback. Sign-in to outside servers also needs the SLATEBOX_KEY_ENCRYPTION_KEY environment variable.

cloudflare.//: Slatebox Cloud only: team addresses (https://<name>.slatebox.team for self-hosted installs, enterprise/team-addresses). Nothing here runs without Slatebox Cloud's own key; leave it out for local development and self-hosting. Server only, never under public. token: a Cloudflare API token with Cloudflare Tunnel Write on accountId and DNS Write, Zone Read and Zone Settings Read on zoneId only, filled from the private settings file, never pasted. paused: true (or leaving teamClaims out) closes the service: every team-address route answers 503 with a plain message, the reconciler does not run and nothing calls Cloudflare; the Admin tools switch pauses new claims only, and live addresses keep working. e2eAccounts: user ids that may claim e2e-* names (the end-to-end test). instance (optional, default public.env): 'prod', 'test' or 'dev', marked on every tunnel name and DNS comment so servers sharing the Cloudflare account and zone never reap each other's; a non-prod instance claims only <instance>-… names (namePrefix overrides).
